projects.title: Projects
projects.desc: I have worked on a variety of projects, from small personal projects to large-scale applications. Here are some of the projects I have worked on.

skyblock.title: SkyBlock Website
skyblock.desc: A collection of simulators and calculators for game mechanics in "Hypixel SkyBlock", built and run on my own, with around 200 monthly visitors. Angular frontend with Tailwind and PrimeNG, plus a small Express backend that proxies requests to the Hypixel API.

homelab.title: Homelab / Self-hosted Infrastructure
homelab.desc: A local Debian server and a Hetzner VPS running several self-hosted services, including Git hosting and photo and media management. I run the Docker containers, Caddy reverse proxies and Cloudflare setup, secure the public services, and handle maintenance and troubleshooting myself.

skyhanni.title: SkyHanni — Contributor
skyhanni.desc: Contributed features and bug fixes to "SkyHanni", a community-driven Minecraft mod written in Kotlin, working in an existing codebase and responding to player-facing issues and community feedback.

swp.title: Software-Praktikum
swp.desc: A university lab course at TU Dortmund in Kotlin with the BGW framework. First a card game built on my own, then the board game "Bonsai" as a team, going through UML design, implementation with daily commits, testing with JUnit, and deployment.
